items.title: Amend the freeze-rule wording in the ablation execution plan (S7 paragraph, S13 M6 exit-criteria row, S17 step 2 echo)
items.context: In docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md: (1) S7 paragraph currently says freeze the powered N computed at the LOWER bound of that CI (conservative) — replace with: freeze the powered N at the N-maximizing baseline within the Wilson 95% CI of the pilot rate (equivalently max over the CI; the lower bound alone is not conservative), matching sample-size.mjs pilotFreezeCheck (p* = 0.5 + mde/2 clamped to the CI). (2) S13 M6 exit-criteria row says powered N frozen at the lower bound of its Wilson 95% CI — align with the corrected rule. (3) S17 step 2 parenthetical echo of the S7 rule — align. Keep everything else unchanged; doc stays entirely English.
items.userSees: git diff main...HEAD touches only the plan doc; the S7 paragraph reads freeze the powered N at the N-maximizing baseline within the Wilson 95% CI and grep -i "lower bound of" no longer matches a freeze-rule sentence in that doc

happy.desc: All three freeze-rule passages (S7 paragraph, S13 M6 exit-criteria row, S17 step 2 echo) state the corrected N-maximizing-baseline rule; grep transcript shows the new wording at all three locations

edge.desc: No stale lower-bound freeze wording remains anywhere in the doc: grep -in for lower-bound freeze phrasing over the plan doc returns no freeze-rule matches

adversarial.desc: Nothing else changed: git diff main...HEAD --stat lists only docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md, and the diff contains only the three freeze-rule passages; doc remains entirely English (no CJK characters introduced)
